content_sections.heading: Official Source

faq.question: Q1. When is the walk-in interview for JNV Boudh Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview is on 21 November 2026, and candidates report at 10:30 AM.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in JNV Boudh Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 4 vacancies: 1 PGT History, 1 PGT Mathematics, 1 TGT Mathematics, 1 TGT PET (M).

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for JNV Boudh Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Attend the walk-in interview on 21 November 2026 at 10:30 AM. The steps and the documents to bring are under How to Apply above.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The maximum age is 50 years (as on 30 July 2026).

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: It depends on the post: Rs.35750 for PGT History, Rs.35750 for PGT Mathematics, Rs.34125 for TGT Mathematics, Rs.34125 for TGT PET (M).

faq.question: Q6. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: PGT History: Master's Degree in concerned subject with at least 50% marks and B.Ed or equivalent. PGT Mathematics: Two-Year Integrated PG M.Sc. from RCE of NCERT with 50% including B.Ed. component, OR Master Degree with 50% in the relevant subject AND B.Ed. from NCTE recognized institution with 50%. TGT Mathematics: graduation with Maths, Physics and Chemistry and 50% marks. TGT PET (M): Bachelor's degree in Physical Education OR D.P.Ed. with a university degree for admission. The requirement for each post is in the eligibility table above.

faq.question: Q7. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. Applicant must sign an undertaking to accept appointment in any of JNVs of Bhopal Region.

faq.question: Q8. Who cannot apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Candidates with B.Sc. (Hons.) in Physics or Chemistry are not eligible for TGT (Maths).

faq.question: Q9. How will candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Document verification. Personal interview. Document verification with original documents.

faq.question: Q10. What are the terms of engagement for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Engagement is purely on a temporary basis. Position is on a contract basis. Appointment is purely on contract and does not confer the right for regularization.
